title: Critical minerals and routes to diversification in Africa: opportunities for diversification into renewable energy technologies – the case of Morocco
publisher: UNCTAD, background paper for the Economic Development in Africa Report 2023
summary: The paper maps the opportunities and challenges for Morocco to diversify into renewable energy technology value chains, and sets out a framework for how the country could localise and capture value in those supply networks.
keyFindings: It identifies two routes to diversification: moving from adopter to producer of solar and solar battery technologies, and electric vehicle batteries and the circular economy.
Regional coordination and industrial development are treated as part of the routes to diversification.
methods: In-depth country case study of Morocco.
